svg.title: Jane's call, end to end
svg.desc: Jane Doe's path through Call360 in seven steps, with mock data at each step. 1, overnight load: Composer DAGs move her data through BigQuery into the Bigtable tables, for example a calls row MBR-000123#2025-01-14 with reason refill delay, plus claims, rx, prior_auth and grievances tables. 2, Jane calls: the agent desktop requests member MBR-000123; the gateway checks the OAuth token and writes the audit trail. 3, read her rows: a prefix scan on MBR-000123# across five tables returns five rows from the last 90 days, about 27 ms per read. 4, few-shot selection: Sentence-BERT picks the closest example, a paid lab claim plus a prior call. 5, pass 1: Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite summarizes: denied non-preferred Rx, prior call about a refill delay, prior authorization approved, billing grievance open. 6, pass 2: the same model formats JSON with the member ID and four talking points. 7, agent desktop: the rep sees the talking points before saying hello.
